subject: Possible account compromise
body: We have found activity in our audit log from an address none of us recognise, going back to earlier today. Resources were created that nobody on the team claims.

subject: Webhooks returning 401
body: Our webhook endpoint started rejecting your deliveries with 401 this morning. We also think the signing secret leaked when someone pushed our config to a public repo. How do we get deliveries working again?
kind: mixed: webhook question with a leaked secret

body: A developer we removed from the team last month still shows up in this week's API logs making calls. Which role should I check?
kind: disguised: permissions question, no security keyword

subject: Evidence for a compliance review
body: Our auditor has asked for access records covering the last six months. Can I export these, and is that period within what you retain?

subject: Export all account data
body: Please tell me how to export everything you hold about one of our end users. We have a GDPR request and need to reply within the month.
kind: mixed: data export with a GDPR request

body: How long do you keep request logs? Our lawyer wants it in writing before we sign the renewal.
kind: mixed: retention question for a lawyer

subject: Need data to stay in the EU
body: One of our customers has asked for written confirmation of where their data is physically stored. Could you point me to something I can share with them?

subject: Restoring a backup
body: We need to restore yesterday's database backup. Before we do, can you confirm the backup is held in the EU? Our contract says it must stay in the EU.
kind: mixed: backup restore with a residency condition

subject: Please add per-project spend caps
body: It would be very useful to set spend caps per project rather than only for the whole organisation. At the moment one team's overspend affects everyone.
We keep hitting the rate limit on one key while the others are idle. Could you add per-key limits so we can share the quota out ourselves?
kind: disguised: rate-limit wording, no feature keyword

subject: Urgent
body: Something is wrong since this morning and we need someone to call us as soon as possible.

subject: Charged twice
body: We were charged twice for October. Please refund the duplicate payment.

subject: Overage charge is wrong
body: The overage on this month's invoice does not match our usage dashboard. We dispute the charge.
Response times were terrible all of Tuesday and our checkout was down for hours. We expect compensation for the lost sales.
